meta.label: Sources

meta.label: Prices
meta.value: Cost of a $1 payout in cents. Sportsbooks: the implied chance of the American odds, vig included. Kalshi: the ask plus its taker fee, 7% x p x (1 - p). Robinhood: the ask plus its 1-cent commission; any exchange fee is not included.

meta.label: Books' line and fair
meta.value: The line most books post; fair is the average across books at that line of the Over's chance with the vig removed. Anytime TD has no fair, since the books only offer Yes.

meta.label: Kalshi and Robinhood rungs
meta.value: Kalshi's 'k+' rung counts as Over k - 0.5; Robinhood's 'Over x' as Over x. A price is shown only where a rung sits exactly on the books' line; the midpoint is interpolated between the two rungs around it.
